quotes: assert _instant(record["made_at"]) == made  # the snapshot's read instant
assert sorted(kept) == [made, next_made]  # the earlier ones stay
verdicts.why: The check verifies the readable record's instant, release, sequence number, and key digest against decrypted snapshots, and detects deletion of a backup forced to have a sequence mismatch. It does not test removal of backups older than 30 × 24 hours, nor fully establish that every kept backup is encrypted, consistent, and checked.
